about_the_game:
Step Into the First Part of the Adventure

After falling from the Tree of Eternity, Alka must overcome the challenges of an unfamiliar world to find her way back home.

Discover the Gravity Rotation Mechanic

The Gravity Rotation Mechanic allows you to shift gravity in four directions—left, right, up, or down. Walls become paths, and ceilings turn into floors.

Art Style

The first of Bitbird’s three planned visual styles is available to play in the demo.

Unique and Challenging Levels

Bitbird Demo features a selection of handcrafted levels that give a glimpse into the variety of challenges awaiting in the full game.

Simple to Learn, Deep to Master

The demo is built around core mechanics that are easy to pick up, yet demand skill and practice to master.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Celeron
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics

short_description: Bitbird is a 2D platformer where players manipulate gravity to overcome challenging levels. The game starts with monochrome pixel-art and evolves through 4-bit, 8-bit, and 16-bit styles inspired by different gaming eras.
